🚨 8. Summary of Action Items & Remediations

  1. Fix Spelling Typos: Rename Alloted -> Allotted in crm.stage ID 2. Fix Hod -> HOD in Stage ID 1. Fix company name in res.company from Canadian Crystaline -> Canadian Crystalline.
  2. Fix Kanban Overflow: Shorten Stage ID 32 header from Details sent, client will respond if required (43 chars) to Details Sent (Client Review).
  3. Fix Button Wrapping: Shorten form button Notify HOD & Salesperson (24 chars) to Notify Team.
  4. Resolve CC Admin Permissions: Grant User ccadmin (UID 11) access to HOD Dashboard (Action 814) and Sales Administrator group if they are intended to manage stage allocations and quotations.
  5. Clean Debranding Leaks: Remove unbranded Odoo strings from 12 email templates, replace Odoo purple (#875A7B) with charcoal (#2c2f32), update support URL to canadiancrystalline.com, and purge OdooBot from active Discuss chat channels.
